question: Does a training-only global scale avoid instability from whitening a near-constant coordinate, and does local context then help beyond focal refitting?
status: Second-round post hoc diagnostic after seeing first-round AURORA OWT/XSum fidelity. No test labels fit weights or select checkpoints; the choice of normalization was informed by those outcomes.
base: Previously frozen seed17 affine OWT readout, all weights frozen
formula: logits_i = W x_i + b + U V standardized(q_i) + c; rank=8

arms.context: mean of up to four immediately preceding full-canvas endpoint states, excluding focal; zero at position0
arms.shuffled: same context feature replaced by an independently chosen other-sequence context during training and a fixed other-sequence context during evaluation

boundaries: Context uses full-canvas positions, including source positions on XSum and latent positions whose native token may be special. Native labels/margins never select features. All compared outputs use the same native lexical evaluation mask.

training.selection: Uniform with replacement over original valid training tokens; deterministic seed61022912; original raw ELF shards recover exact full-canvas preceding states
training.init: V normal std 1/sqrt(D), U and output bias zero
training.normalization: Per-dimension training means; one scalar root mean coordinate variance from training only, repeated over all coordinates. Context and shuffled share statistics.
training.selection_rule: Maximum native agreement on fixed original validation tokens; earliest checkpoint on ties; baseline step0 eligible
training.precision: FP32 parameters and evaluation; BF16 training matrix multiplications; TF32 disabled

evaluation: All original prospective OWT conditions/seeds and all4096 XSum generations; no XSum fitting, selection, or retuning. Store full selected predictions.
primary_diagnostics: context minus focal native agreement, macro per sequence
rare-token native agreement and corrected-versus-new errors
inference: Exploratory descriptive paired bootstrap; average two adapter fits; preserve condition/seed and paired XSum document structure. No quality or acceleration claim from fidelity alone.
limits: Rank8 and four preceding states test a narrow cheap context model, not all contextual decoders or the full diffusion mechanism. Prior tests were already observed. Additional fit seeds are not independently trained generators.
resources: One low-priority GPU worker,3.5GiB allocator ceiling,2CPUthreads,nice10; no denoiser training/generation.
change: Keep per-dimension training means but divide all dimensions by s=sqrt(mean_j Var_train(q_j)); no coordinate-specific variance inversion, clipping, learned gate, new rank, or learning-rate tuning.
observed_trigger: First-round AURORA adapters fail on XSum despite near-baseline OWT fidelity; OWT coordinate86 has SD below1e-4 and XSum variance is much larger. The replacement rule is global, identical for all coordinates/families/arms, and uses training statistics only.
